name: Basirhat
registryAssessment: Basirhat local administrative and land-record provenance is evidenced: the official Basirhat Municipality site identifies the municipality and lists the Sub-Divisional Land & Land Reforms Officer, the North 24 Parganas district site places Basirhat Municipality and Basirhat-I/II blocks in the Basirhat subdivision, and West Bengal's official Banglarbhumi portal provides plot-map, mouza-map, plot-information and ROR services. This establishes a local/state registry procedure and custodian path, not open parcel-vector integration.

queries.query: Basirhat West Bengal official cadastral parcel map land records Banglarbhumi plot map
queries.result: Found the official West Bengal Banglarbhumi portal with Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request, Plot Information and ROR services; official Basirhat Municipality map page; official North 24 Parganas subdivision listing; and the West Bengal government mouza-map request form. No public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or bounded ID+geometry response was exposed.

queries.query: বাসিরহাট সরকারি জমির নকশা খতিয়ান দাগ মানচিত্র
queries.result: Bengali-language discovery resolved to the official Banglarbhumi land-record portal and Bengali cadastral terminology for plot/dag, khatian and mouza-map services, but did not identify an anonymous public parcel geometry API.

officialSources.role: West Bengal Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department official land-record portal
officialSources.observation: Search discovery showed Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request, RS-LR Plot Information, ROR and related citizen services. Direct anonymous HTTPS GET timed out after 25 seconds in this attempt; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials or private token was used.

Search discovery lists Basirhat ward, land-use and baseline map downloads. It is municipal planning/map material, not evidence of parcel-vector schema or parcel identity. Direct curl DNS resolution failed from this host.
Search discovery lists the Sub-Divisional Land & Land Reforms Officer and local administrative contacts, establishing a local custodian path; no parcel data was requested or retained.

officialSources.role: Official North 24 Parganas district administrative listing
officialSources.observation: Anonymous GET returned HTTP 200. The page places Basirhat Municipality and Basirhat-I/II among the Basirhat subdivision units; it contains no parcel geometry endpoint.

officialSources.role: West Bengal government mouza-map request form
officialSources.observation: Search discovery describes the official application for RS scanned/LR digitized mouza maps addressed to the District Land & Land Reforms Officer, with district, police station, mouza, JL and sheet fields. Direct PDF request timed out; no map was obtained.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. Portal timeout, DNS failure, and non-cadastral municipal map material do not establish citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Basirhat Municipality, North 24 Parganas Basirhat subdivision, West Bengal Banglarbhumi official land-record services, and the government mouza-map request route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local/state registry and procedure provenance was established, but anonymous parcel-vector access, schema, CRS, native identity, exact-point containment and citywide coverage were not verified.
